summary: Local Streamlit tool that imports Elder Scrolls books and applies reviewable taxonomy tags.
current_priorities: Validate the binary parser against real-world plugin variants.
Improve batch import and review ergonomics only when usage justifies it.
constraints: Use the mock provider for routine validation when model calls are unnecessary.
